regime_context: China A-shares thematic detector shows narrow leadership with Semiconductors and AI Compute dominating the top ranks; only 5 of 22 themes are eligible. Backtest verdict indicates the absolute trend gate did not reduce drawdown on this market’s history, and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0. Macro narrative backdrop is geopolitics and AI tech but provides no tradable edge. Any directional lean is therefore low conviction, experimental, and subject to strict falsification.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors currently lead in momentum rank and are trend-eligible with no crowding. Given the backtest showing no edge from the trend gate here, this lean is treated as an experimental, discipline-driven tilt rather than an alpha call. The overweight is conditional on the trend remaining intact; a break below the 20-day moving average would invalidate.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC ~0 means leadership is not predictive of future returns; the trend gate did not historically reduce drawdown, so whipsaw risk is high. The theme may mean-revert.

falsifier.text: ETF 512760.SS closes below its 20-day simple moving average on daily data.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Despite high durability (0.85) and eligibility, the theme is crowded (crowding_z=1.24). Per guardrails, crowding is a sizing caution, not a fade signal. We avoid initiating new positions; existing holdings may be maintained but not added to.
theses.dissent: High durability and trend strength could continue to attract flows; crowding alone does not predict reversals, and themes can stay crowded for extended periods. The caution may underweight a genuine sustained move.

falsifier.text: Crowding_z drops below 1.0 and breadth expands above 0.85, or a new catalyst breaks the crowded consensus.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
